note: Live conductor down across the approach road. Area cordoned and the section isolated before any gang approached.
Patrol finds seven spans of conductor down between poles 14 and 21.
Four cross-arms broken. Insulator strings intact.
Fallen tree blocking the line route. A tree-cutting gang is required before line work can start.
Night working suspended on the Kulti section. Standing water around the pole bases and no safe access with the trunk still live upstream.
Six insulators found cracked by hail during patrolling.
Lineman sustained a minor laceration while clearing a fallen span. Treated on site, no lost time.
Field flooded to knee depth. The gang cannot reach the downed spans and work is deferred until the water recedes.
Water receded overnight. Access restored and conductor stringing resumed.
All snapped-conductor sites cleared and released for normal operation.
